question: This novel's protagonist declares himself to be “of flesh and bone, fiber and liquids— and I might even be said to possess a mind.” In this novel, the protagonist leads a rich trustee to Jim Trueblood's cabin and a seedy bar, causing him to be expelled from college by Dr. (*) Bledsoe. The unnamed narrator of this novel is sealed underground following a riot encouraged by the Brotherhood, whose members include Ras the Exhorter. A “Battle Royale” scene occurs in, for 10 points, what Ralph Ellison novel about a person who others “refuse to see”?
